## Angular Filter Component

The [Kendo UI for Angular Filter](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/filter) component provides options for building and editing filter expressions. The Filter can be used on its own or with other Kendo UI for Angular components.

## Key Features

Among the many features which the Kendo UI for Angular Filter delivers are:

* [Data Binding](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/filter/filters-configuration)&mdash;The Filter component allows you to provide user-defined filters of type [FilterExpression](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/filter/api/filterexpression).
* [Value Binding](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/filter/value-binding)&mdash;The Filter component allows you to set its initial value of type [CompositeFilterDescriptor](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/data-query/api/compositefilterdescriptor).
* [Expression Value Template](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/filter/expression-value-template)&mdash;The Filter component provides a template which enables you to customize the value input field of each filter expression to your own requirements. 
* [Filter Editor Formats](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/filter/editor-formats)&mdash;You have the ability to set default formats for the numeric and date filter editors of the filter expressions.
* [Globalization](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/filter/globalization)&mdash;By using the available globalization options in Kendo UI for Angular, you can translate the Filter messages by adapting them to specific culture locales. Additionally, the Filter supports rendering in a right-to-left (RTL) direction.
* [Accessibility](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/filter/accessibility)&mdash;The Filter is accessible for screen readers and support WAI-ARIA attributes.
* [Keyboard Navigation](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/filter/keyboard-navigation)&mdash;The Filter supports a number of keyboard shortcuts which allow users to accomplish various commands.
